questions.prompt: Who was the first European monarch to break with the Roman Catholic Church in the 1530s?
questions.fact: The Pope had earlier given him a title defending the faith, which English monarchs still carry today.

questions.prompt: Which gas makes up the majority of the air we exhale?
questions.fact: Nitrogen passes through untouched, and exhaled air still contains about 16 percent oxygen, which is what makes rescue breathing work.

questions.prompt: How wide is a regulation football goal?
questions.fact: The figure is 8 yards converted, which is why it comes out at such an awkward metric number.

questions.prompt: Which musician was known as Slowhand?
questions.fact: The nickname came from audiences slow-clapping while he changed a broken string mid-song.

questions.prompt: Which country has the world's highest waterfall by uninterrupted drop?
questions.fact: It was unknown outside the region until an American pilot crash-landed nearby in 1937.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Never Let Me Go?
questions.fact: He has said he tried the same premise twice before, over fifteen years, and abandoned both attempts.

questions.prompt: Which company created the PostScript page description language?
questions.fact: Combined with the laser printer and a Mac, it created desktop publishing more or less overnight.
